messages.subject: Sortable SelectInput and CheckboxGroupInput
parts:
I have been working on some projects that would benefit from sortable select inputs. I want to share some of my results and ask for additional help and inputs.

I was delighted to find out that Seletize has a couple cool plugins built-in:
https://github.com/brianreavis/selectize.js/tree/master/src/plugins

Both drag_drop and remove_button seem to be quite useful. They can easily enabled by:
`selectizeInput(...,  options = list(plugins = list("drag_drop", "remove_button")))`
https://gist.github.com/saurfang/6684a66601a7e5b6467f
You can see this by: 
shiny::runGist("6684a66601a7e5b6467f")

*there is a small complication that you need to add jQuery UI dependency


This is all well and good except that occasionally it would be great if the values can be updated as you drag and drop. I tinkered a little bit but was not very successful. However, I was able to hack CheckboxGroupInput to have my desired effects:
https://gist.github.com/saurfang/cdb93616e955c17e6599

I made my attempt to be as non-invasive as I can be to the core Shiny.js and focus my hack on the visual behavior instead. I can see another potential approach would be to modify the Shiny.js so that the input binding only grabs values that are visible or not helper/placeholder. This allows more flexibility on sortable configuration but I feel this has its own implications that could disrupt other legitimate use cases.



So first I propose adding some examples or possibly an `plugins` argument in the `selectizeInput` function to show the awesome functionality of plugins.
Secondly, I'm wondering if anyone is interested to try enabling binding updates while dragging/dropping for selectize input in an elegant way.

Lastly, just to give you some perspectives on how this is a useful feature, here is one of the examples:
https://saurfang.shinyapps.io/shinyCorrplot
